```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(broom)
library(glmnet)
library(caret)
library(Matrix)    
library(dplyr)
library(rjson)
library(tibble)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r functions}
# load pfactor data and merge with demographics
load_pfactor_data <- function(file_path) {
  pfactor <- fread(file_path)
  pfactor <- pfactor %>% rename(sub = participant_id)
  pfactor$sub <- paste0("sub-", pfactor$sub)
  pfactor <- pfactor %>% select(sub, p_factor_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples, internalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples, externalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples, attention_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples)
  pfactor <- pfactor[!duplicated(pfactor), ]
  pfactor <- pfactor[complete.cases(pfactor), ]
  return(pfactor)
}


ridge_cv <- function(X, y, covars_df, outer_folds = 10, inner_folds = 10, alpha = 0) {
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == length(y), nrow(X) == nrow(covars_df))
  N <- nrow(X)

  # Precompute outer folds (shuffle for randomness)
  set.seed(42)
  outer <- caret::createFolds(y, k = outer_folds, returnTrain = TRUE)

  # Storage
  fold_R2   <- numeric(outer_folds)
  fold_lambda <- numeric(outer_folds)
  y_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, N)         # out-of-fold predictions (brain score)
  coef_list <- vector("list", outer_folds)  # coefficients per fold (penalized part)

  # Helper to residualize (train fit, then apply to test)
  resid_train_test <- function(vec_or_mat_train, vec_or_mat_test, Ctrain, Ctest) {
    # Add intercept
    Ctr  <- cbind(Intercept = 1, as.matrix(Ctrain))
    Cte  <- cbind(Intercept = 1, as.matrix(Ctest))

    # Solve least squares for each column efficiently:
    # for y (vector) or X (matrix)
    if (is.vector(vec_or_mat_train)) {
      b <- solve(crossprod(Ctr), crossprod(Ctr, vec_or_mat_train))
      ytr_res <- vec_or_mat_train - as.vector(Ctr %*% b)
      yte_res <- vec_or_mat_test  - as.vector(Cte %*% b)
      return(list(train = ytr_res, test = yte_res))
    } else {
      # matrix case: return residualized matrices (columnwise in one shot)
      b <- solve(crossprod(Ctr), crossprod(Ctr, vec_or_mat_train))
      Xtr_res <- vec_or_mat_train - Ctr %*% b
      Xte_res <- vec_or_mat_test  - Cte %*% b
      return(list(train = Xtr_res, test = Xte_res))
    }
  }

  for (i in seq_along(outer)) {
    tr <- outer[[i]]
    te <- setdiff(seq_len(N), tr)

    Xtr <- X[tr, , drop = FALSE]
    Xte <- X[te, , drop = FALSE]
    ytr <- y[tr]
    yte <- y[te]
    Ctr <- covars_df[tr, , drop = FALSE]
    Cte <- covars_df[te, , drop = FALSE]

    # 1) Residualize y on covariates (train fit → apply to test)
    y_res <- resid_train_test(ytr, yte, Ctr, Cte)
    ytr_resid <- y_res$train
    yte_resid <- y_res$test

    # 2) (Recommended) Residualize EACH COLUMN of X on covariates
    X_res <- resid_train_test(Xtr, Xte, Ctr, Cte)
    Xtr_resid <- X_res$train
    Xte_resid <- X_res$test

    # 3) Scale using train statistics only
    Xtr_sc <- scale(Xtr_resid, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
    xm <- attr(Xtr_sc, "scaled:center"); xs <- attr(Xtr_sc, "scaled:scale")
    Xte_sc <- scale(Xte_resid, center = xm, scale = xs)

    ytr_sc <- as.numeric(scale(ytr_resid, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
    ym <- mean(ytr_resid); ys <- sd(ytr_resid)
    yte_sc <- as.numeric((yte_resid - ym) / ys)

    # 4) Inner CV to choose lambda (ridge: alpha=0)
    fit <- cv.glmnet(Xtr_sc, ytr_sc, alpha = alpha, nfolds = inner_folds,
                     standardize = FALSE, intercept = TRUE)

    # 5) Predict held-out test fold
    yhat <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = Xte_sc, s = "lambda.min"))
    y_hat_oof[te] <- yhat

    # 6) Out-of-sample R^2 for this fold
    fold_R2[i] <- 1 - mean((yte_sc - yhat)^2) / var(yte_sc)
    fold_lambda[i] <- fit$lambda.min

    # 7) Store penalized coefficients at lambda.min (on scaled X)
    coef_list[[i]] <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = "lambda.min"))  # includes intercept
  }

  list(
    mean_cv_R2 = mean(fold_R2),
    fold_R2 = fold_R2,
    lambda_min = fold_lambda,
    brain_score_oof = y_hat_oof,    # cross-validated "brain score" per subject
    coef_by_fold = coef_list        # ridge weights (scaled space)
  )
}



ridge_cv_sparse <- function(X, y, covars_df, outer_folds = 10, inner_folds = 5, alpha = 0) {
  N <- nrow(X)
  outer <- caret::createFolds(y, k = outer_folds, returnTrain = TRUE)

  fold_R2   <- numeric(outer_folds)
  fold_lambda <- numeric(outer_folds)
  y_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, N)

  # helper: residualize train/test within fold
  resid_train_test <- function(vec_or_mat_train, vec_or_mat_test, Ctrain, Ctest) {
    Ctr <- cbind(1, as.matrix(Ctrain))
    Cte <- cbind(1, as.matrix(Ctest))
    if (is.vector(vec_or_mat_train)) {
      b <- solve(crossprod(Ctr), crossprod(Ctr, vec_or_mat_train))
      list(train = vec_or_mat_train - as.vector(Ctr %*% b),
           test  = vec_or_mat_test  - as.vector(Cte %*% b))
    } else {
      b <- solve(crossprod(Ctr), crossprod(Ctr, vec_or_mat_train))
      list(train = vec_or_mat_train - Ctr %*% b,
           test  = vec_or_mat_test  - Cte %*% b)
    }
  }

  for (i in seq_along(outer)) {
    tr <- outer[[i]]; te <- setdiff(seq_len(N), tr)
    Xtr <- X[tr, , drop = FALSE]; Xte <- X[te, , drop = FALSE]
    ytr <- y[tr]; yte <- y[te]
    Ctr <- covars_df[tr, , drop = FALSE]; Cte <- covars_df[te, , drop = FALSE]

    # residualize y and X
    y_res <- resid_train_test(ytr, yte, Ctr, Cte)
    X_res <- resid_train_test(Xtr, Xte, Ctr, Cte)
    ytr_res <- scale(y_res$train, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
    yte_res <- (y_res$test - mean(y_res$train)) / sd(y_res$train)

    # scale X using train means/SDs
    Xtr_sc <- scale(X_res$train, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
    xm <- attr(Xtr_sc, "scaled:center"); xs <- attr(Xtr_sc, "scaled:scale")
    Xte_sc <- scale(X_res$test, center = xm, scale = xs)

    # inner-CV ridge
    fit <- cv.glmnet(Xtr_sc, ytr_res, alpha = alpha, nfolds = inner_folds,
                     standardize = FALSE, intercept = TRUE)
    yhat <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = Xte_sc, s = "lambda.min"))

    y_hat_oof[te] <- yhat
    fold_R2[i] <- 1 - mean((yte_res - yhat)^2) / var(yte_res)
    fold_lambda[i] <- fit$lambda.min
    cat("Fold", i, "R² =", round(fold_R2[i], 4), "\n")
  }

  list(mean_cv_R2 = mean(fold_R2),
       fold_R2 = fold_R2,
       lambda_min = fold_lambda,
       brain_score_oof = y_hat_oof)
}



permute_ridge <- function(X, y, covars_df, B = 1000, ...) {
  obs <- ridge_cv(X, y, covars_df, ...)$mean_cv_R2
  nulls <- numeric(B)
  set.seed(123)
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    y_perm <- sample(y)   # permute labels
    nulls[b] <- ridge_cv(X, y_perm, covars_df, ...)$mean_cv_R2
  }
  p_perm <- mean(nulls >= obs)
  list(observed = obs, null = nulls, p_perm = p_perm)
}

# Function to summarize key stats and compare models
compare_models <- function(m1, m2, var_name) {
  df1 <- broom::tidy(m1)
  df2 <- broom::tidy(m2)

  # find whatever sex dummy term exists (e.g., "sexmale")
  sex_term1 <- df1[grep("^sex", df1$term), ]
  sex_term2 <- df2[grep("^sex", df2$term), ]
  brain_term <- df2[grep(paste0("brain_oof_", var_name), df2$term), ]

  cat("\n====", var_name, "====\n")
  cat("ΔR² =", summary(m2)$adj.r.squared - summary(m1)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
  cat("Sex effect before brain:  β =", round(sex_term1$estimate, 3), "p =", round(sex_term1$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("Sex effect after brain:   β =", round(sex_term2$estimate, 3), "p =", round(sex_term2$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("Brain effect:             β =", round(brain_term$estimate, 3), "p =", round(brain_term$p.value, 4), "\n")
}
```

```{r load files for regionlevel ridge}
PNC_config_data <- fromJSON(file=sprintf("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/sex_diff/code/config/config_%1$s.json", "PNC"))
HCPD_config_data <- fromJSON(file=sprintf("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/sex_diff/code/config/config_%1$s.json", "HCPD"))
NKI_config_data <- fromJSON(file=sprintf("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/sex_diff/code/config/config_%1$s.json", "NKI"))
HBN_config_data <- fromJSON(file=sprintf("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/sex_diff/code/config/config_%1$s.json", "HBN"))


# load demographics for all datasets and combine
PNC_demographics <- read.csv(PNC_config_data$demographics, stringsAsFactors = TRUE) %>% mutate(dataset_site = "PNC") %>% select(sub, age, sex, meanFD_avgSes, dataset_site)
NKI_demographics <- read.csv(NKI_config_data$demographics, stringsAsFactors = TRUE) %>% mutate(dataset_site = "NKI") %>% select(sub, age, sex, meanFD_avgSes, dataset_site)
HBN_demographics <- read.csv(HBN_config_data$demographics, stringsAsFactors = TRUE) %>% rename(site = ses) %>% mutate(dataset_site = paste0("HBN_", site)) %>% select(sub, age, sex, meanFD_avgSes, dataset_site)

# load clinical measures
PNC_pfactor <- load_pfactor_data("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/pfactor/input/PNC/sample_info/study-PNC_desc-participants.tsv")
NKI_pfactor <- load_pfactor_data("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/pfactor/input/NKI/sample_info/study-NKI_desc-participants.tsv")
NKI_pfactor$sub <- gsub("sub-", "", NKI_pfactor$sub)
HBN_pfactor <- load_pfactor_data("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/pfactor/input/HBN/sample_info/study-HBN_desc-participants.tsv")

# merge demographics and clinical measures
PNC_demographics <- inner_join(PNC_pfactor, PNC_demographics,by = "sub")
NKI_demographics <- inner_join(NKI_pfactor, NKI_demographics,by = "sub")
HBN_demographics <- inner_join(HBN_pfactor, HBN_demographics,by = "sub")

demographics <- rbind(PNC_demographics, NKI_demographics, HBN_demographics)

# load WNC data
WNC_all_datasets <- read.csv("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/sex_diff/output/all_datasets/WNC/WNC_subxparcel_matrix_schaefer200x17_covbat.csv")
WNC_all_datasets <- WNC_all_datasets[,-1]
WNC_all_datasets <- WNC_all_datasets %>% rename(sub = subject)
ridge_WNC_data <- merge(WNC_all_datasets, demographics, by = "sub")

# load edge-level data
edge_all_datasets <- readRDS("/cbica/projects/network_replication/covariate_analyses/sex_diff/output/all_datasets/edge/subxedge_schaefer200x17_covbat.RData")
colnames(edge_all_datasets) <- gsub("X17", "", colnames(edge_all_datasets))
edge_all_datasets <- edge_all_datasets %>% rename(sub = subject)
ridge_edge_data <- merge(edge_all_datasets, demographics, by = "sub")
```


# region level ridge
```{r make inputs for regionlevel ridge}
# select only the 200 FC features (your within-network connectivity columns)
X_regions <- as.matrix(ridge_WNC_data %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("Networks_")))

# check dimensions
dim(X_regions)  # should be 2502 x 200

# create the y
y_p   <- ridge_WNC_data$p_factor_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples
y_int <- ridge_WNC_data$internalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples
y_ext <- ridge_WNC_data$externalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples
y_att <- ridge_WNC_data$attention_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples

# create covariates df
covars_df <- data.frame(
  age = ridge_WNC_data$age,
  mean_fd = ridge_WNC_data$meanFD_avgSes,
  sex = as.numeric(ridge_WNC_data$sex)
)

```


```{r run for regionlevel ridge}
# pfactor
res_regions_p <- ridge_cv(X = X_regions, y = y_p, covars_df = covars_df)
res_regions_p$mean_cv_R2
res_regions_p$fold_R2

# internalizing
res_regions_int <- ridge_cv(X_regions, y_int, covars_df)
res_regions_int$mean_cv_R2
res_regions_int$fold_R2

# externalizing
res_regions_ext <- ridge_cv(X_regions, y_ext, covars_df)
res_regions_ext$mean_cv_R2
res_regions_ext$fold_R2

# attention
res_regions_att <- ridge_cv(X_regions, y_att, covars_df)
res_regions_att$mean_cv_R2
res_regions_att$fold_R2

results_table_regions <- tibble(
  Dataset = c("p-factor", "internalizing", "externalizing", "attention"),
  Mean_CV_R2 = c(res_regions_p$mean_cv_R2,
                 res_regions_int$mean_cv_R2,
                 res_regions_ext$mean_cv_R2,
                 res_regions_att$mean_cv_R2)
)

results_table_regions
```

# simple mediation with brain scores (out-of-fold predicted values of clinical measures)

```{r mediation for WNC score}
ridge_WNC_data$brain_oof_p   <- res_regions_p$brain_score_oof
ridge_WNC_data$brain_oof_int <- res_regions_int$brain_score_oof
ridge_WNC_data$brain_oof_ext <- res_regions_ext$brain_score_oof


# Ensure numeric coding: 0 = male, 1 = female
ridge_WNC_data$sex_num <- as.numeric(ridge_WNC_data$sex == "F")

# Model 1: symptoms ~ sex + covariates
m1_p <- lm(p_factor_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples ~ sex + age + meanFD_avgSes, data = ridge_WNC_data)
m1_i <- lm(internalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples ~ sex + age + meanFD_avgSes, data = ridge_WNC_data)
m1_e <- lm(externalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples ~ sex + age + meanFD_avgSes, data = ridge_WNC_data)

# Model 2: add brain score
m2_p <- lm(p_factor_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples ~ sex + brain_oof_p + age + meanFD_avgSes, data = ridge_WNC_data)
m2_i <- lm(internalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples ~ sex + brain_oof_int + age + meanFD_avgSes, data = ridge_WNC_data)
m2_e <- lm(externalizing_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples ~ sex + brain_oof_ext + age + meanFD_avgSes, data = ridge_WNC_data)


compare_models(m1_p, m2_p, "p")
compare_models(m1_i, m2_i, "int")
compare_models(m1_e, m2_e, "ext")
```

